records.literal_gloss: For the director, a maskil of David,

en.L: For the director: a maskil of David,
en.B: For the music director. A maskil of David,
en.R: For the leader of the music. A song by David to teach and give insight.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : un maskil de David,
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Un maskil de David,
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. Un chant de David pour enseigner et faire comprendre.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: maskili ya Daudi,
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Maskili ya Daudi,
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Wimbo wa Daudi wa kufundisha na kutia ufahamu.

es.L: Al director del coro: un masquil de David,
es.B: Al director del coro. Un masquil de David,
es.R: Para el director de la música. Un canto de David para enseñar y dar sabiduría.

decisions.choice: The title is verses 1-2
decisions.reason: The Hebrew counts this psalm's long title as two verses, so the verse numbers here are two higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: maskil: probably a skillful or instructive song
decisions.reason: As in 32:1, the word (maskil) comes from a verb meaning to be wise or to give insight. Its exact sense as a kind of song is no longer known.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: The title continues into verse 2, which says when the psalm was written, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: a song to teach and give insight
decisions.reason: Readable gives the likely sense of the term, as in 42:1.

source.text: בְּב֤וֹא׀דּוֹאֵ֣ג הָאֲדֹמִי֮ וַיַּגֵּ֪ד לְשָׁ֫א֥וּל וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֑וֹ בָּ֥א דָ֝וִ֗ד אֶל־בֵּ֥ית אֲחִימֶֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: when came Doeg the Edomite and told Saul and said to him, Has come David to [the] house of Ahimelech.

en.L: when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said to him, "David has come to the house of Ahimelech."
en.B: when Doeg the Edomite went and informed Saul, telling him, "David has gone to Ahimelech's house."
en.R: It is from the time when Doeg from Edom went to King Saul and told him, "David went to Ahimelech's house."

fr.L: quand Doëg l’Édomite vint et informa Saül, et lui dit : « David est venu à la maison d’Ahimélek. »
fr.B: quand Doëg l’Édomite alla avertir Saül en lui disant : « David s’est rendu chez Ahimélek. »
fr.R: Il date du moment où Doëg, un homme d’Édom, est allé voir le roi Saül et lui a dit : « David est allé chez Ahimélek. »

sw.L: Doegi Mwedomu alipokuja akamwambia Sauli, akasema naye, "Daudi amekuja nyumbani kwa Ahimeleki."
sw.B: Doegi Mwedomu alipokwenda kumpasha Sauli habari, akimwambia, "Daudi amekwenda nyumbani kwa Ahimeleki."
sw.R: Ni kutoka wakati ule Doegi, mtu wa Edomu, alipokwenda kwa Mfalme Sauli na kumwambia, "Daudi alikwenda nyumbani kwa Ahimeleki."

es.L: cuando vino Doeg el edomita y avisó a Saúl, y le dijo: «David ha venido a la casa de Ahimelec».
es.B: cuando Doeg el edomita fue a informar a Saúl, diciéndole: «David ha ido a casa de Ahimelec».
es.R: Es de cuando Doeg, que era de Edom, fue a ver al rey Saúl y le dijo: «David fue a casa de Ahimelec».

decisions.choice: The title is verses 1-2
decisions.reason: The Hebrew counts this psalm's long title as two verses, so the verse numbers here are two higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: Doeg and Ahimelech: 1 Samuel 21-22
decisions.reason: Fleeing from Saul, David received bread and Goliath's sword from Ahimelech, the priest at Nob. Doeg, an Edomite who was the chief of Saul's herdsmen, saw it and reported it to Saul; at Saul's order Doeg then killed eighty-five priests and struck down the town of Nob (1 Samuel 21; 22:9-19).

decisions.choice: the Edomite: a foreigner in Saul's service
decisions.reason: Edom, the nation descended from Esau, was often hostile to Israel. Doeg's origin is named to set him apart from the people of God he betrayed.

decisions.choice: King Saul
decisions.reason: Readable says who Saul was, and starts a new sentence, since the title of verse 1 ends there.

source.text: מַה־תִּתְהַלֵּ֣ל בְּ֭רָעָה הַגִּבּ֑וֹר חֶ֥סֶד אֵ֝֗ל כָּל־הַיּֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: Why do you boast in evil, the mighty [man]? [The] loyal love of God [is] all the day.

en.L: Why do you boast in evil, mighty man? \q The loyal love of God [endures] all the day.
en.B: Why brag about evil, you mighty warrior? \q God's loyal love goes on all day long.
en.R: Why do you brag about the evil things you do, you powerful man? \q God's faithful love never stops.

fr.L: Pourquoi te glorifies-tu du mal, homme puissant ? \q L’amour loyal de Dieu [dure] tout le jour.
fr.B: Pourquoi te vanter du mal, toi le vaillant guerrier ? \q L’amour fidèle de Dieu dure tout le jour.
fr.R: Pourquoi te vantes-tu du mal que tu fais, homme puissant ? \q L’amour fidèle de Dieu ne s’arrête jamais.

sw.L: Kwa nini unajivuna kwa uovu, ewe mtu hodari? \q Upendo usiokoma wa Mungu [unadumu] mchana kutwa.
sw.B: Kwa nini kujigamba kwa uovu, ewe shujaa? \q Upendo usiokoma wa Mungu unaendelea mchana kutwa.
sw.R: Kwa nini unajisifu kwa maovu unayoyatenda, ewe mtu mwenye nguvu? \q Upendo usiokoma wa Mungu haukomi kamwe.

es.L: ¿Por qué te jactas del mal, hombre poderoso? \q El amor leal de Dios [dura] todo el día.
es.B: ¿Por qué presumes de la maldad, guerrero poderoso? \q El amor fiel de Dios sigue todo el día.
es.R: ¿Por qué presumes de las cosas malas que haces, hombre poderoso? \q El amor fiel de Dios nunca se detiene.

decisions.choice: mighty man: a warrior, said with scorn
decisions.reason: The word (gibbor) is used of warriors and heroes. Here it mocks a man proud of his power to harm; the title links him with Doeg.

decisions.choice: the loyal love of God
decisions.reason: The words read "the loyal love (chesed) of God": the man boasts of evil, but God's faithful love outlasts it. A rare second sense of chesed is "shame" (Leviticus 20:17), which would give "a disgrace to God", and the ancient Greek translation reads the line differently.

decisions.choice: all the day: all the time
decisions.reason: "All the day" means continually, without a break.

decisions.choice: goes on all day long (B); never stops (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply a verb for the second line.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

source.text: הַ֭וּוֹת תַּחְשֹׁ֣ב לְשׁוֹנֶ֑ךָ כְּתַ֥עַר מְ֝לֻטָּ֗שׁ עֹשֵׂ֥ה רְמִיָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Destruction plots your tongue, like a razor sharpened, worker of deceit.

en.L: Destruction your tongue plots, \q like a sharpened razor, [you] worker of deceit.
en.B: Your tongue devises ruin; \q it cuts like a honed razor, you schemer of lies.
en.R: You use your words to plan ways to destroy people. \q Your tongue is as sharp as a razor. \q You are always tricking people.

fr.L: Des ruines, ta langue [en] médite, \q comme un rasoir affilé, [toi] artisan de tromperie.
fr.B: Ta langue trame la ruine ; \q elle tranche comme un rasoir aiguisé, toi, fabricant de mensonges.
fr.R: Tu te sers de tes paroles pour préparer la ruine des autres. \q Ta langue est coupante comme un rasoir. \q Tu trompes toujours les gens.

sw.L: Maangamizi ulimi wako unapanga, \q kama wembe ulionolewa, [ewe] mtenda hila.
sw.B: Ulimi wako unabuni maangamizi; \q unakata kama wembe uliopigwa makali, ewe mtunga uongo.
sw.R: Unatumia maneno yako kupanga njia za kuwaangamiza watu. \q Ulimi wako ni mkali kama wembe. \q Daima unawadanganya watu.

es.L: Destrucción trama tu lengua, \q como navaja afilada, [tú] obrador de engaño.
es.B: Tu lengua planea la ruina; \q corta como una navaja bien afilada, tramador de mentiras.
es.R: Usas tus palabras para planear cómo destruir a la gente. \q Tu lengua es tan afilada como una navaja. \q Siempre estás engañando a los demás.

decisions.choice: destruction: ruin brought on others
decisions.reason: The word (hawwot) means disaster and ruin; it comes back in verse 9 ("his destruction").

decisions.choice: your tongue plots: you plan harm with your words
decisions.reason: The tongue stands for the whole man: his harm is done by speaking, as Doeg's report to Saul led to the killing of the priests.

decisions.choice: like a sharpened razor: words that cut
decisions.reason: Words are often pictured as blades (55:22; 57:5; 59:8).

decisions.choice: You use your words to plan
decisions.reason: Readable says what the tongue stands for (m2).

source.text: אָהַ֣בְתָּ רָּ֣ע מִטּ֑וֹב שֶׁ֓קֶר׀מִדַּבֵּ֖ר צֶ֣דֶק סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: You love evil more than good, falsehood more than speaking righteousness. Selah.

en.L: You love evil more than good, \q falsehood more than speaking righteousness. Selah
en.B: You prefer evil to good, \q and a lie to an honest word. Selah
en.R: You like doing evil more than doing good. \q You would rather lie than tell the truth. Selah

fr.L: Tu aimes le mal plus que le bien, \q le mensonge plus que de dire la justice. Sélah
fr.B: Tu préfères le mal au bien, \q et le mensonge à une parole honnête. Sélah
fr.R: Tu aimes faire le mal plus que faire le bien. \q Tu préfères mentir plutôt que dire la vérité. Sélah

sw.L: Unapenda uovu kuliko wema, \q uongo kuliko kusema haki. Sela
sw.B: Unachagua ubaya kuliko wema, \q na uongo kuliko neno la kweli. Sela
sw.R: Unapenda kutenda maovu kuliko kutenda mema. \q Ni afadhali kwako kusema uongo kuliko kusema kweli. Sela

es.L: Amas el mal más que el bien, \q la mentira más que hablar justicia. Selah
es.B: Prefieres el mal al bien, \q y la mentira a la palabra honesta. Selah
es.R: Te gusta más hacer el mal que hacer el bien. \q Prefieres mentir a decir la verdad. Selah

decisions.choice: more than: rather than
decisions.reason: The comparison may mean that he loves good not at all, a Hebrew way of saying "instead of".

decisions.choice: righteousness: what is right and true
decisions.reason: In speech, righteousness (tsedeq) is saying what is true and just.

decisions.choice: an honest word (B); tell the truth (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense (m2).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

records.literal_gloss: You love all words of swallowing, tongue of deceit.

en.L: You love all words that swallow up, \q [you] tongue of deceit.
en.B: You love every word that devours, \q you lying tongue.
en.R: You love to say things that hurt and ruin people. \q You are a liar!

fr.L: Tu aimes toutes les paroles qui engloutissent, \q [toi] langue de tromperie.
fr.B: Tu aimes toute parole qui dévore, \q langue menteuse !
fr.R: Tu aimes dire des choses qui blessent et détruisent les gens. \q Tu es un menteur !

sw.L: Unapenda maneno yote yanayomeza, \q [ewe] ulimi wa hila.
sw.B: Unapenda kila neno linaloangamiza, \q ewe ulimi wa uongo.
sw.R: Unapenda kusema mambo yanayowaumiza na kuwaangamiza watu. \q Wewe ni mwongo!

es.L: Amas todas las palabras que devoran, \q [oh] lengua de engaño.
es.B: Amas toda palabra que destruye, \q lengua mentirosa.
es.R: Te encanta decir cosas que lastiman y arruinan a la gente. \q ¡Eres un mentiroso!

decisions.choice: words of swallowing: words that destroy
decisions.reason: The enemy who "swallows" a person destroys them completely (35:25).

decisions.choice: tongue of deceit: the man addressed as his tongue
decisions.reason: The man is called by the part of him that does the harm, as in verse 4.

decisions.choice: You are a liar
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m2).

source.text: גַּם־אֵל֮ יִתָּצְךָ֪ לָ֫נֶ֥צַח יַחְתְּךָ֣ וְיִסָּחֲךָ֣ מֵאֹ֑הֶל וְשֵֽׁרֶשְׁךָ֨מֵאֶ֖רֶץ חַיִּ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Also God will tear you down forever; he will snatch you and tear you away from [the] tent, and uproot you from [the] land of living. Selah.

en.L: God also will tear you down forever; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will snatch you up and pluck you from [your] tent, \q and uproot you from the land of the living. Selah
en.B: But God will bring you down for good; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will seize you and drag you out of your tent, \q and pull you up by the roots from the land of the living. Selah
en.R: But God will destroy you forever. \q He will grab you and drag you out of your home. \q He will pull you up like a plant and take you away from the world of the living. Selah

fr.L: Dieu aussi te démolira pour toujours ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te saisira et t’arrachera de [ta] tente, \q et te déracinera de la terre des vivants. Sélah
fr.B: Mais Dieu t’abattra pour de bon ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’empoignera et te tirera hors de ta tente, \q et t’arrachera avec tes racines de la terre des vivants. Sélah
fr.R: Mais Dieu te détruira pour toujours. \q Il t’attrapera et te tirera hors de ta maison. \q Il t’arrachera comme une plante et t’enlèvera du monde des vivants. Sélah

sw.L: Mungu naye atakubomoa milele; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atakunyakua na kukung'oa kutoka hema [lako], \q na kukung'oa mizizi kutoka nchi ya walio hai. Sela
sw.B: Lakini Mungu atakuangusha kabisa; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} atakukamata na kukuburuta nje ya hema lako, \q na kukung'oa kwa mizizi kutoka nchi ya walio hai. Sela
sw.R: Lakini Mungu atakuangamiza milele. \q Atakushika na kukuburuta nje ya nyumba yako. \q Atakung'oa kama mmea na kukuondoa katika ulimwengu wa walio hai. Sela

es.L: Dios también te derribará para siempre; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te arrebatará y te arrancará de [tu] tienda, \q y te desarraigará de la tierra de los vivientes. Selah
es.B: Pero Dios te derribará para siempre; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te agarrará y te sacará a rastras de tu tienda, \q y te arrancará de raíz de la tierra de los vivos. Selah
es.R: Pero Dios te destruirá para siempre. \q Te agarrará y te sacará a rastras de tu casa. \q Te arrancará como a una planta y te quitará del mundo de los vivos. Selah

decisions.choice: tear down, snatch, tear away, uproot
decisions.reason: Four verbs picture God's judgment: a building torn down (natats), coals snatched from a fire (chatah, Proverbs 6:27), a man torn from his home (nasach), and a tree pulled up by its roots (sharash). The uprooted man stands against the flourishing olive tree of verse 10.

decisions.choice: the land of the living: life on earth
decisions.reason: As in 27:13: the world of people alive, as against the grave.

decisions.choice: also: in turn
decisions.reason: "Also" (gam) answers the man's harm with God's: as he destroyed, so God will destroy him.

decisions.choice: home
decisions.reason: A tent was a dwelling; Readable says "home".

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

records.literal_gloss: And will see [the] righteous and will fear, and at him they will laugh:

en.L: And the righteous will see and fear, \q and they will laugh at him,
en.B: The righteous will see it and be filled with awe; \q they will laugh at him and say,
en.R: People who do what is right will see this and be filled with awe. \q They will laugh at him and say,

fr.L: Et les justes verront et craindront, \q et ils riront de lui,
fr.B: Les justes le verront et seront saisis de crainte ; \q ils riront de lui et diront :
fr.R: Ceux qui font ce qui est juste verront cela et seront remplis de crainte. \q Ils riront de lui et diront :

sw.L: Na wenye haki wataona na kuogopa, \q nao watamcheka,
sw.B: Wenye haki wataona hayo na kujaa hofu takatifu; \q watamcheka na kusema,
sw.R: Watu wanaotenda yaliyo haki wataona jambo hili na kujaa hofu takatifu. \q Watamcheka na kusema,

es.L: Y los justos verán y temerán, \q y se reirán de él,
es.B: Los justos lo verán y se llenarán de asombro; \q se reirán de él y dirán:
es.R: Los que hacen lo que es justo verán esto y se llenarán de asombro. \q Se reirán de él y dirán:

decisions.choice: fear: be struck with awe
decisions.reason: The righteous are not afraid of the man; they stand in awe of God's judgment (40:4; 64:10).

decisions.choice: laugh at him: see his pride brought down
decisions.reason: The laughter is the triumph of seeing the proud man's boasting proved empty, as God laughs at the wicked (2:4; 37:13).

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: Verse 9 gives what the righteous say, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: and say
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "and say" to introduce the words of verse 9.

decisions.choice: People who do what is right
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable explains tsaddiq.

decisions.choice: "les justes" (Literal, Balanced); "ceux qui font ce qui est juste" (Readable)
decisions.reason: Tsaddiq is the person who lives rightly before God. "Le juste" is the word for it throughout this translation; Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

source.text: הִנֵּ֤ה הַגֶּ֗בֶר לֹ֤א יָשִׂ֥ים אֱלֹהִ֗ים מָֽע֫וּזּ֥וֹ וַ֭יִּבְטַח בְּרֹ֣ב עָשְׁר֑וֹ יָ֝עֹ֗ז בְּהַוָּתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, the man [who] did not make God his stronghold, and trusted in [the] abundance of his riches, sought safety in his destruction.

en.L: "Look, the man [who] would not make God his stronghold, \q but trusted in the abundance of his riches, \q [and] sought safety in his destruction."
en.B: "Look at the man who would not take God as his fortress! \q He relied on his great wealth \q and looked for safety in the ruin he caused."
en.R: "Look at that man! He did not trust God to keep him safe. \q He trusted his money instead. \q He thought his power to destroy people would protect him."

fr.L: « Voici l’homme [qui] n’a pas fait de Dieu sa forteresse, \q mais s’est confié dans l’abondance de sa richesse, \q [et] a cherché refuge dans sa ruine. »
fr.B: « Voyez l’homme qui n’a pas voulu prendre Dieu pour forteresse ! \q Il comptait sur ses grandes richesses \q et cherchait sa sécurité dans la ruine qu’il causait. »
fr.R: « Regardez cet homme ! Il n’a pas compté sur Dieu pour le protéger. \q Il a eu confiance en son argent. \q Il pensait que son pouvoir de détruire les gens le protégerait. »

sw.L: "Tazama, mtu [ambaye] hakumfanya Mungu ngome yake, \q bali alitumainia wingi wa mali zake, \q [na] kutafuta usalama katika maangamizi yake."
sw.B: "Mtazameni mtu ambaye hakumchukua Mungu kuwa ngome yake! \q Alitegemea utajiri wake mwingi \q na kutafuta usalama katika maangamizi aliyoyasababisha."
sw.R: "Mtazameni mtu yule! Hakumtegemea Mungu amlinde. \q Badala yake alitegemea fedha zake. \q Alidhani uwezo wake wa kuwaangamiza watu ungemlinda."

es.L: «He aquí el hombre [que] no quiso hacer de Dios su fortaleza, \q sino que confió en la abundancia de sus riquezas, \q [y] buscó seguridad en su destrucción».
es.B: «¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}} al hombre que no quiso tomar a Dios por fortaleza! \q Se apoyó en su gran riqueza \q y buscó seguridad en la ruina que causaba».
es.R: «¡{{plural_you:Miren|Mirad}} a ese hombre! No confió en que Dios lo protegiera. \q En cambio, confió en su dinero. \q Creyó que su poder para destruir a la gente lo protegería».

decisions.choice: stronghold, sought safety: a play on words
decisions.reason: "Stronghold" (ma'oz) and "sought safety" ('uz) come from the same root: the man would not take shelter in God, so he took shelter in the harm he did.

decisions.choice: his destruction: the ruin he brings on others
decisions.reason: The word is that of verse 4 (hawwot). Some ancient translations read "his wealth", a similar word, in parallel with "his riches".

decisions.choice: the man: the mighty man of verse 3
decisions.reason: The righteous speak of the one addressed in verses 3-7.

decisions.choice: his power to destroy people
decisions.reason: Readable says what "his destruction" means (m2).

source.text: וַאֲנִ֤י׀כְּזַ֣יִת רַ֭עֲנָן בְּבֵ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים בָּטַ֥חְתִּי בְחֶֽסֶד־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים עוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: But I [am] like an olive tree flourishing in [the] house of God; I trust in [the] loyal love of God forever and ever.

en.L: But I [am] like a flourishing olive tree in the house of God; \q I trust in the loyal love of God forever and ever.
en.B: I, though, am like an olive tree in full leaf in God's house; \q I rely on God's loyal love forever and ever.
en.R: But I am like a healthy, green olive tree growing at God's house. \q I will always trust God's faithful love.

fr.L: Mais moi, [je suis] comme un olivier verdoyant dans la maison de Dieu ; \q je me confie dans l’amour loyal de Dieu pour toujours et à jamais.
fr.B: Mais moi, je suis comme un olivier couvert de feuilles dans la maison de Dieu ; \q je compte sur l’amour fidèle de Dieu pour toujours et à jamais.
fr.R: Mais moi, je suis comme un olivier vert et bien vivant, qui pousse près de la maison de Dieu. \q J’aurai toujours confiance en l’amour fidèle de Dieu.

sw.L: Lakini mimi [ni] kama mzeituni unaostawi katika nyumba ya Mungu; \q ninatumainia upendo usiokoma wa Mungu milele na milele.
sw.B: Lakini mimi ni kama mzeituni wenye majani mengi katika nyumba ya Mungu; \q ninategemea upendo usiokoma wa Mungu milele na milele.
sw.R: Lakini mimi ni kama mzeituni wenye afya na majani mabichi unaokua nyumbani mwa Mungu. \q Nitautegemea upendo usiokoma wa Mungu siku zote.

es.L: Pero yo [soy] como olivo frondoso en la casa de Dios; \q confío en el amor leal de Dios por siempre y para siempre.
es.B: Yo, en cambio, soy como un olivo lleno de hojas en la casa de Dios; \q me apoyo en el amor fiel de Dios por siempre jamás.
es.R: Pero yo soy como un olivo sano y verde que crece junto a la casa de Dios. \q Siempre confiaré en el amor fiel de Dios.

decisions.choice: a flourishing olive tree: a long, fruitful life
decisions.reason: The olive tree is evergreen and lives for centuries; it pictures a life that lasts and bears fruit (128:3; Jeremiah 11:16). Unlike the uprooted man of verse 7, the psalmist is rooted near God.

decisions.choice: in the house of God: near God's presence
decisions.reason: Trees may have grown in the temple courts (92:14). The picture is of a life lived close to God.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: As in 5:8 (chesed): the love that keeps faith and does not give up.

decisions.choice: But I: the contrast with the man
decisions.reason: The emphatic "I" sets the psalmist against the man of verses 3-9: he trusted in riches, the psalmist in God's loyal love.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

source.text: אוֹדְךָ֣ לְ֭עוֹלָם כִּ֣י עָשִׂ֑יתָ וַאֲקַוֶּ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֥ כִֽי־ט֝֗וֹב נֶ֣גֶד חֲסִידֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: I will thank you forever, for you have acted, and I will wait for your name, for [it is] good, before your faithful ones.

en.L: I will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} forever, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have acted; \q and I will wait for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, for [it is] good, \q before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful ones.
en.B: I will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} forever for what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done; \q before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal people I will wait in hope on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, \q because it is good.
en.R: I will always thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done. \q I will wait for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to help me, \q in front of all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful people, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are good.

fr.L: Je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrai grâce pour toujours, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as agi ; \q et j’espérerai en {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, car [il est] bon, \q devant {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} fidèles.
fr.B: Je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendrai grâce pour toujours de ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait ; \q devant {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple fidèle j’attendrai avec espoir {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, \q car il est bon.
fr.R: Je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercierai toujours pour ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait. \q J’attendrai que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} viennes m’aider, \q devant tout {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple fidèle, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es bon.

sw.L: Nitakushukuru milele, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umetenda; \q nami nitalingojea jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, kwa maana [ni] jema, \q mbele ya waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Nitakushukuru milele kwa yale {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliyoyatenda; \q mbele ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} waaminifu nitalitumainia jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, \q kwa sababu ni jema.
sw.R: Nitakushukuru siku zote kwa yale {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} uliyoyafanya. \q Nitakungoja {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unisaidie, \q mbele ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wote waaminifu, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mwema.

es.L: Te daré gracias para siempre, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has actuado; \q y esperaré en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, porque [es] bueno, \q delante de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} fieles.
es.B: Te daré gracias para siempre por lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho; \q delante de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo leal esperaré con esperanza en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, \q porque es bueno.
es.R: Siempre {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daré gracias por lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho. \q Esperaré a que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me ayudes, \q delante de todo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo fiel, porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres bueno.

decisions.choice: you have acted: God has done it
decisions.reason: The verb has no object: God has done what the psalm expects, judging the boaster. The past form speaks of it as already done.

decisions.choice: your name: God himself as he has made himself known
decisions.reason: To wait for God's name is to wait in hope for God to show who he is by acting (5:12; 9:11).

decisions.choice: your faithful ones: the people loyal to God
decisions.reason: The word (chasidim) is related to chesed: those who return God's loyal love with their own (4:4).

decisions.choice: for it is good: God's name is good
alternatives: for it is good to do so before your faithful ones
decisions.reason: "Good" most likely describes God's name; it could describe the waiting and praising done among God's people.

decisions.choice: wait for you to help me ... you are good
alternatives: wait for your name ... it is good
decisions.reason: Readable says "you" for God's name (m2).
